meta.subject: Duplicate sgpr busy table decoder fix in the vgpr's.

en.summary: Fixes the VGPR busy-table decoder so an invalid register operand decodes to zero instead of spuriously marking a busy entry.
why_it_counts: The patch changes issue-stage RTL that feeds register busy tracking.
It fixes false hazard generation in core scheduling logic, not verification code.
The commit mirrors an existing SGPR decoder fix, which reinforces the intended hardware behavior.
evidence: vgpr_busy_table_decoder.v changes the decode to output zero when no vgpr_valid bit is asserted.
The old logic always shifted vgpr_valid by vgpr_addr even when vgpr_valid was all zero.
The matching sgpr_busy_table_decoder.v already contained the same valid-gating pattern.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A busy-table or scoreboard decoder must emit no one-hot selection when the source operand is invalid. If the decoder still shifts an address using stale operand bits while validity is false, it can assert a false busy bit and create artificial hazards, stalling issue logic or blocking legal instructions.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: invalid-operand gating on register busy decode
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: The issue logic presents a register address alongside an operand-valid indication that is deasserted.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Remove the valid gate around the one-hot decoder so the address is decoded even when the operand is invalid.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: drop valid gating on one-hot decoder
portability_notes: Apply this to scoreboards, busy tables, or dependency decoders for any register file type.
The key fault is false dependency creation from an invalid operand slot.
This bug often manifests as unexplained issue stalls rather than wrong arithmetic results.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the one-hot decode or shift logic that marks a register as busy for an operand slot.
Bypass the operand-valid check so the decode runs whenever an address value is present, even if the slot is invalid.
Keep the rest of the scoreboard update logic unchanged so the failure comes from a spurious decode.

repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix gates the shifted decode with (|vgpr_valid), matching the SGPR decoder so invalid VGPR selections produce a zero decode.
repository_grounding.mutation_strategy: drop valid gating on one-hot decoder
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Replace the guarded assign to output_decoded_2 with the older unconditional vgpr_valid << vgpr_addr form.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Invalid operand slots spuriously mark VGPR entries busy, causing false hazards, unnecessary stalls, or blocked issue opportunities.
evidence_for_injection: The fix is a one-line validity guard around the decode expression.
The file lives under src/verilog/rtl/issue, which is central scheduler logic.
The SGPR decoder already had the same protection, showing the previous VGPR behavior was inconsistent.
notes: This is a reusable scoreboard injection pattern for many microarchitectures.
Validation should focus on false dependencies and lost issue throughput under invalid operand combinations.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 VGPR busy-table decoder，使无效寄存器操作数会解码为零，而不是错误地标记某个 busy 项。
why_it_counts: 补丁修改的是 issue 阶段 RTL 中用于寄存器 busy 跟踪的逻辑。
它修复的是核心调度逻辑中的伪相关生成，而不是验证代码。
该提交复用了 SGPR decoder 中已有的同类修复，进一步说明这才是期望的硬件行为。
evidence: vgpr_busy_table_decoder.v 现在在没有任何 vgpr_valid 位被置位时输出零解码。
旧逻辑即便 vgpr_valid 全零，也会按 vgpr_addr 对 vgpr_valid 做移位。
对应的 sgpr_busy_table_decoder.v 早已包含同样的 valid gating 模式。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: busy-table 或 scoreboard decoder 在源操作数无效时，必须输出空的 one-hot 选择。如果有效位为假时，decoder 仍然使用陈旧的地址位进行移位解码，就可能错误地拉高某个 busy bit，制造伪相关，从而让发射逻辑停顿或阻塞原本合法的指令。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 寄存器 busy 解码中的无效操作数 gating
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: issue 逻辑给出一个寄存器地址，同时对应的 operand-valid 指示为低。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 去掉 one-hot decoder 上的有效位保护，使其在操作数无效时仍然对地址进行解码。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: drop valid gating on one-hot decoder
portability_notes: 适用于任何寄存器文件类型的 scoreboard、busy table 或依赖解码器。
该缺陷的核心是在无效操作数槽位上产生伪依赖。
它常常表现为无法解释的 issue 停顿，而不是直接的算术错误。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到对某个操作数槽位进行 one-hot 解码或移位以标记寄存器 busy 的逻辑。
旁路 operand-valid 检查，使得只要地址值存在就执行解码，即便该槽位无效。
保持其余 scoreboard 更新逻辑不变，使故障来源于伪解码。

repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复使用 (|vgpr_valid) 对移位解码进行 gating，并与 SGPR decoder 保持一致，使无效 VGPR 选择输出零解码。
repository_grounding.mutation_strategy: drop valid gating on one-hot decoder
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 把 output_decoded_2 的受保护赋值改回旧的无条件 vgpr_valid << vgpr_addr 形式。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 无效操作数槽位会错误地把 VGPR 项标记为 busy，导致伪相关、不必要的停顿，或发射机会被阻塞。
evidence_for_injection: 修复就是在解码表达式外增加了一行有效位保护。
该文件位于 src/verilog/rtl/issue 下，是核心调度逻辑的一部分。
SGPR decoder 早已有相同保护，说明此前 VGPR 行为不一致。
notes: 这是一个对很多微架构都适用的 scoreboard 注入模式。
验证时应重点观察无效操作数组合下的伪相关和发射吞吐损失。
